examples.sql: CREATE TABLE Sample.MyNames ( LastName CHAR(30), FirstName CHAR(30) COLLATE SQLstring)
SELECT TOP 5 Name,$LENGTH(Name) AS NLen, %SQLUPPER(Name) AS UpCollN,$LENGTH(%SQLUPPER(Name)) AS UpCollLen, UPPER(Name) AS UpN,$LENGTH(UPPER(Name)) AS UpLen FROM Sample.Person
SELECT Home_City FROM Sample.Person WHERE Home_City = 'albany'
SELECT Home_City FROM Sample.Person WHERE Home_City [ 'c' ORDER BY Home_City
SELECT %EXACT(Name) FROM Sample.Person GROUP BY Name
SELECT Name FROM Sample.Person GROUP BY %EXACT(Name)
